description: A 27-year designed ecological garden in Wattle Glen. Planted for foliage greens and greys across canopy, midstorey and dense understorey, the garden functions as a haven for small birds. No irrigation has been used since establishment. Directly adjoins 11 acres of Trust for Nature covenanted bush. First registry garden in Nillumbik.

soil_water.mulch_type: Recovered timber (pallets and untreated fencing -- waste stream)

habitat.planting_method: Three simultaneous layers planted at establishment. ~220 eucalypts at commencement. 500-1000 plants per year ongoing as regeneration. No irrigation -- zero supplementary water since establishment.
materials: Retained habitat stem (standing dead tree, pruned to safe height)
Deliberate untended zones (small-bird refuge from currawong predation)
Pond with waterfall and bio-filters at both ends

connectivity.park_name: Trust for Nature environmental covenant (11 acres, immediately below garden boundary)

milestones.title: Confirm Sam Cox consent for transcript use

activity_log.title: Initial site visit and enrolment -- Tyson + Natasha
activity_log.notes: First formal evidence artefact. Photo set captured. Garden age ~27 years. No irrigation system, entire establishment under recovered-timber mulch and mounded topography. Abundant fungal fruiting bodies observed across the garden (peak season, Aug 2026). Pond with waterfall and bio-filters. Standing dead tree retained as habitat stem. Rockwork throughout. Deliberate untended zones for small-bird refuge. Direct adjacency to 11 acres Trust for Nature covenanted bush with documented fauna movement across the boundary. Species inventory and canopy cover measurement deferred to return visit.

notes: Provisional enrolment -- single site visit, no species list, no formal assessment complete. Return visit required for species survey, canopy cover, area_sqm, EVC lookup, and Sam Cox consent for transcript. Mulch and mounding detail (100m3 recovered timber, mounded topography for water capture) confirmed by Tyson + Natasha as witnesses but conversation was unrecorded -- written confirmation from Sam Cox outstanding.
